terminals.name: dottie-workspace
terminals.command: source ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null; cd "${DOTTIE_ROOT:-.}" && uv sync --all-groups --frozen || uv sync --all-groups; printf '\n[ready] DOTTIE_ROOT=%s\n' "${DOTTIE_ROOT:-$(pwd)}"
terminals.description: Ensure uv workspace is synced and shell env is loaded for dottie development.
